transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Nisha, I'm Emily Wilson. I've been looking at my latest bill and there's a a charge for a premium subscription service that I never signed up for.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing issues with your billing, Ms. Wilson. I can certainly look into this for you.
Customer: It's just frustrating because this is the second time this has happened in three months.
Agent: I understand how annoying that is. Let me check the account associated with 98694 81769.
Customer: Yes, that's my number.
Agent: I see the charge here. I guarantee you'll get a full refund on this.
Customer: Okay, that sounds fair. How long will it take to show up on my statement?
Agent: Please note that any refund or credit is subject to approval and will typically take 7-10 business days to process.
Customer: Wait, you just said you guaranteed it, but now you are saying it's subject to approval? That's contradictory.
Agent: I just mean that the process requires a formal request which I have now submitted.
Customer: This is ridiculous. I'm tired of these hidden charges and the conflicting information. I'm going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.
Customer: I don't want to hear any more excuses. Just get it done.
Agent: I am sorry you feel that way, but I cannot process the cancellation right now as the refund request is pending.
Customer: What? This is absolute garbage! I'm leaving as soon as I find a new plan!
Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with today? I have submitted the refund request for review. Goodbye.
